item.title: About
item.description:
One operator, one AI, zero mutual understanding — yet. This is where I document the journey of setting up, training, and working with Cortana and AI in general: the wins, the drills, and the failures worth remembering.

PromptAndLoad is named after lock and load, with one word swapped — because that’s what this is: ready the prompt, send it, see what the machine does with it.

New here? Start with the Logs, steal from the Loadouts, and learn from the Fired so you don’t have to break the same things I did.
